cases.subject: Re: Wspólne przetargi - raport z postępów po trzech tygodniach
cases.body:
Szanowny Panie Wiktorze,

dziękuję za Pańską krótką odpowiedź. Chciałbym w nawiązaniu do niej przekazać pełniejszy raport z postępów w naszych wspólnych przetargach, ponieważ w ostatnich dniach nastąpiło kilka istotnych zmian, a nie chciałbym, aby dowiedział się Pan o nich z drugiej ręki.

Przetarg dla sieci handlowej: dokumentacja jest kompletna w dziewięćdziesięciu procentach. Brakuje jeszcze zaświadczeń o niekaralności i polisy ubezpieczeniowej, które nasz dział prawny odbierze w tym tygodniu. Model kosztowy został zaakceptowany przez obie strony, a marża mieści się w założeniach, które uzgodniliśmy na początku współpracy.

Przetarg na transport chłodniczy: komisja zakończyła ocenę formalną i dopuściła obie nasze oferty. Rozmowy z komisją odbędą się w lutym, a harmonogram prześlę, gdy tylko zostanie opublikowany.

Przetarg trzeci, na przewozy kontenerowe: zamawiający przesunął ogłoszenie warunków na marzec, więc nie ma tu jeszcze nic do robienia. Nasz zespół obserwuje sytuację i przygotuje wstępną analizę.

Zasadniczo wszystko przebiega zgodnie z planem i żadna z tych informacji nie wymaga od Pana decyzji. Piszę po to, by miał Pan aktualny obraz. Następne podsumowanie przekażę za dwa tygodnie, chyba że wcześniej coś się zmieni.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners

cases.subject: Nordic framework agreement - the story so far, for the file
cases.body:
Hi Wiktor,

since the Nordic framework is about to be signed, here is a longer summary of how we got here, in case you want it for your records or for the board. It needs no action from you.

The first talks started last spring, when Karin's company asked for a quote on weekly chilled shipments from Poznan to Gothenburg. We started with a single trial lane in May, and the trial went well: on-time delivery above ninety-five percent, no damage claims, and the paperwork handled by Daniel's broker team without delays. In September, they asked us for a framework agreement covering four lanes and a volume estimate for the next two years.

The negotiation was mostly about three points. The liability clause, which took two rounds. The price review mechanism, tied to the Swedish diesel index. And the delivery windows at their new distribution centre. All three are now agreed, with only some wording to polish. Piotr did a very good job here, and their lawyers said so.

What is next: signing on 22 January, a kick-off call the week after, and the first shipments under the framework in February. Halina has the trailers ready, and Karin's team will confirm the labels.

I think this one is a big deal for us. Nothing to do from your side, but I wanted you to have the full picture.

Oliver

cases.subject: Logistyka Dziś: karty i opłaty - przegląd rynku
cases.body:
Logistyka Dziś, wydanie piątkowe

Rynek kart paliwowych dla firm transportowych w Polsce rośnie szybciej niż rynek paliw. Najwięksi dostawcy poszerzają oferty o płatności za parkingi i myjnie, a część wprowadza karty na stacjach ładowania pojazdów elektrycznych.

Eksperci radzą, aby przy porównywaniu ofert zwracać uwagę na opłaty stałe, które w niektórych pakietach rosną w drugim roku umowy. Dobrym zwyczajem jest ustalenie w umowie limitu wzrostu opłat.

Wybór karty zależy od tras. Przewoźnicy krajowi korzystają głównie z kart sieciowych, a międzynarodowi z kart wielosieciowych, które działają w kilku krajach.

cases.subject: Joint ventures - an overview of what we achieved in the first year
cases.body:
Dear Wiktor,

Now that the first year of our joint venture is behind us, I would like to share some thoughts and numbers in one place. This is not a request for anything, but I believe you will find the picture useful, especially before the board meets at the end of the month.

Results. We submitted nine joint tenders and won four, which gives a hit rate of about forty-four percent, well above the market average of around twenty-five. The total yearly value of the contracts we won is close to eleven million zloty. Our shared model shows a margin that is slightly above what we planned.

Operations. The cooperation between our brokers and your logistics teams has become routine. The average time between a won tender and the first shipment fell from five weeks to three. We also introduced a single contact desk for customers of the joint offers, which they appreciate.

Lessons. The tenders we lost were mostly lost on price for ancillary services. For next year, we plan to prepare simpler price structures for such services. Another lesson is that early involvement of customs specialists helps in tenders that include cross-border lanes.

Outlook. We expect a similar number of tenders in the coming year, with a growing share of chilled transport. Several large customers announced framework tenders for the second half of the year.

I am grateful for the trust and the good atmosphere in our cooperation, and I look forward to the next twelve months.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners

cases.subject: Supply Chain Weekly: rates, regulation and a look at warehousing
cases.body:
Supply Chain Weekly - the weekly digest

Rates. Container spot rates were mixed this week, with a small rise on Asia to North Europe and a small fall on trans-Atlantic lanes. Reefer rates held steady.

Regulation. The European Commission published draft guidance on the new customs data hub. Forwarders say the project may simplify declarations, but warn that the implementation will take several years.

Warehousing. Prime logistics rents in Central Europe rose by about two percent in the quarter, and developers say that demand remains high from food and e-commerce tenants.

The full report is available to paid subscribers.

cases.subject: Supply Chain Weekly: Baltic update
cases.body:
Supply Chain Weekly - Baltic update

Baltic ports handled more containers in December than a year earlier, helped by transhipment from the North Sea. Gdansk reached a monthly record, and Gdynia added a new service to Scandinavia.

Rail links between Poland and the Baltic states improved after the completion of works on the main line, which cut transit times by five hours.

Subscribers can read the detailed port statistics in the paid edition.

Karin Lindqvist

cases.subject: Re: Nordic lanes - capacity from the joint venture side
cases.body:
Dear Wiktor,

Thank you for your reply, and for the kind words about the cooperation. I would like to follow up with a more complete picture of what the joint venture can offer on the Nordic lanes, since Oliver raised the subject and you showed interest. I will keep this as an overview, as nothing needs deciding now.

Capacity. We have twelve dedicated trucks for Scandinavia in the second quarter, and two subcontractors who can add six more in peak weeks. The trucks are modern, with full temperature logging, which fits the requirements of Nordic Foods Trade and other importers of chilled goods.

Customs. Our brokers already hold the registrations needed for the new pre-notification system. The clearance times for chilled goods have fallen to an average of 34 minutes, and we do not see this changing after February.

Commercial model. For any new Nordic lane, we propose to use the same cost model as in the current joint tenders, which both sides already know. A first indicative price could be ready within a week of receiving the lane details.

I will not push this further unless a concrete request arrives. For now I simply wanted you and Oliver to know what we can do.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners
